Name: The Fool
Upright Effect: Reveal the top card of each player's deck, including yours. You may place one of them. Remove the rest from the game.
Reversed Effect: Deal 5 damage to each player, including you.

Name: The Magician
Upright Effect: Place a card. You may reverse this card.
Reversed Effect: Draw 3, then discard 3. If you cannot do either, you win the game.

Name: The High Priestess
Upright Effect: Name a card. Choose a player to reveal cards from their deck until they reveal the named card. If they do, put the revealed cards in their memory. Otherwise, that player shuffles.
Reversed Effect: Place any number of cards face-down. Each player may flip a face-down card face up at any time to activate it and silence it.

Name: The Empress
Upright Effect: If The Emperor is on your spread, you win the game.
Reversed Effect: You may place a card from any player's memory, then silence it and reverse this card.

Name: The Emperor
Upright Effect: If The Empress is on your spread, you win the game.
Reversed Effect: You may replace any other card on your spread with a card from any player's spread, then reverse this card.

Name: The Hierophant
Upright Effect: Choose Wands, Cups, Swords, or Pentacles. Remove all cards that aren’t of the chosen suit, including Major cards, from the game.
Reversed Effect: Dismiss all Major cards. For each card dismissed this way, its player may place a Minor card from their hand to that position.

Name: The Lovers
Upright Effect: Each player chooses to draw 2 or gain 5 life.
Reversed Effect: Each opponent must discard. If they cannot, deal 3 damage to them.

Name: The Chariot
Upright Effect: Take a card and put it on your spread. You may reverse it. You cannot replace Major cards this way.
Reversed Effect: Remove all cards in a player's memory from the game.

Name: Strength
Upright Effect: Deal damage to an opponent equal to half their life rounded down, then deal that much damage to yourself. This cannot reduce your life total to less than 1.
Reversed Effect: Choose any number up to 10. Deal that much damage to each player, including you.

Name: The Hermit
Upright Effect: You may dismiss this card to reveal cards from your deck until you reveal a Major card. You may replace this card with it or draw it. Shuffle your deck.
Reversed Effect: Each player chooses up to 2 cards. Dismiss all other cards.

Name: The Wheel of Fortune
Upright Effect: Flip a coin. If you win, gain 5 life and flip again. Repeat until you lose a flip.
Reversed Effect: Choose an opponent. Flip a coin. Deal 2 damage to the loser. The winner may flip again, doubling the damage dealt that flip. Repeat this process until the winner chooses not to flip.

Name: Justice
Upright Effect: The player with the least life gains 5 life, then deal 5 damage to the player with the most life. If there is a tie, you choose.
Reversed Effect: The player with the greatest life gains 5 life, then deal 5 damage to the player with the least life. If there is a tie, you choose.

Name: The Hanged Man
Upright Effect: Dismiss any number of cards on your spread. On this turn, whenever you place a card, you may place an additional card for each card you dismissed.
Reversed Effect: The next time a player's life total would be reduced to less than 1, it is reduced to 1 instead.

Name: Death
Upright Effect: Place up to 3 cards. Deal damage to a player equal to 5 minus the number of cards placed.
Reversed Effect: Dismiss up to 3 cards on your spread. Deal 5 damage to a player for each card dismissed.

Name: Temperance
Upright Effect: Deal damage to players who have more life than the lowest life total until all players have the same life total.
Reversed Effect: If you have the lowest life total among all players, increase your life total to the lowest life total among all other players.

Name: The Devil
Upright Effect: Deal 3 damage to each opponent. Gain 1 life for each opponent damaged this way.
Reversed Effect: Remove all cards on your spread from the game, including this card. For the rest of the game, whenever you would place a card, you may pay 2 life to place a card from your memory instead.

Name: The Tower
Upright Effect: Remove this card from the game. Shuffle all cards into their players' decks. Starting with you, each player places 2 cards and cannot replace cards this way.
Reversed Effect: Remove this card from the game, then flip all cards. Each player may flip a face-down card at any time to activate it and silence it.

Name: The Star
Upright Effect: Gain 3 life. If you have at least 10 more life than each opponent, you win the game.
Reversed Effect: Deal 2 damage to each player, including you, then deal damage to each opponent equal to the damage you have dealt to them this turn.

Name: The Moon
Upright Effect: Return all other cards to their players' hands and remove this card from the game. Starting with you, each player places 2 cards to any other player's spread.
Reversed Effect: For each card in an opponent's hand and spread, its player moves one card from their deck to memory.

Name: The Sun
Upright Effect: If you have fewer than 5 cards in hand, you may draw until you have 5 cards in hand. You may draw to less than 5.
Reversed Effect: Deal damage to each player, including you, equal to the number of cards in their hand.

Name: Judgement
Upright Effect: Dismiss all cards, including this card. For each card on an opponent's spread dismissed this way, deal 2 damage to that player.
Reversed Effect: Dismiss this card. Place up to 3 cards.

Name: The World
Upright Effect: Put a counter on The World, then deal damage to each opponent equal to the number of counters on The World.
Reversed Effect: Put 7 counters on The World. If there are 21 or more counters on The World, reverse it.

Name: Ace of Pentacles
Upright Effect: Deal 2 damage to yourself. The next time you place a card, draw 2.
Reversed Effect: Dismiss a non-Wand, non-Pentacle card.

Name: 2 of Pentacles
Upright Effect: Deal damage to a player equal to the number of cards in their hand.
Reversed Effect: Exchange the positions of two cards. You may reverse them. If both cards are on spreads other than yours, draw.

Name: 3 of Pentacles
Upright Effect: Choose a player to reveal their hand. Choose a card from it. That player discards that card.
Reversed Effect: Deal damage to each player equal to 5 minus the number of cards they have in hand. If the damage is negative, that player draws that many.

Name: 4 of Pentacles
Upright Effect: Dismiss this card. Take a card and put it on your spread. At the end of your next turn, dismiss that card.
Reversed Effect: Deal 2 damage to any number of players, then those players each draw.

Name: 5 of Pentacles
Upright Effect: Each opponent with a Major card or a Swords card on their spread discards.
Reversed Effect: If you have fewer than 2 cards in hand, draw until you have 2 cards in hand.

Name: 6 of Pentacles
Upright Effect: Gain life equal to the number of cards you have in hand.
Reversed Effect: Each opponent may give you a card from their hand. Deal 3 damage to each opponent who doesn't.

Name: 7 of Pentacles
Upright Effect: Put a counter on this card. You may dismiss this card. If you do, your life total becomes equal to 7 times the number of counters on this card.
Reversed Effect: Choose a player with at least one card in their hand. That player discards their hand, then draws that many minus 1.

Name: 8 of Pentacles
Upright Effect: Copy an effect of either side of a card on another player's spread.
Reversed Effect: You may reveal a Major card or Pentacles card from your hand. If you do, place it.

Name: 9 of Pentacles
Upright Effect: Until the end of this turn, whenever you place a card, you may draw.
Reversed Effect: Return any number of cards from your memory to your hand. Deal damage to yourself equal to the number of cards returned.

Name: 10 of Pentacles
Upright Effect: Place a card from your memory.
Reversed Effect: Choose up to three cards from one player's memory and remove them from the game.

Name: Page of Pentacles
Upright Effect: Reveal any number of cards from your hand. For each Pentacles card you revealed and each Pentacles card on your spread, deal 2 damage to a player and gain 1 life.
Reversed Effect: Choose up to 3 cards from your memory. For each chosen card, remove that card from the game and deal 1 damage to any player.

Name: Knight of Pentacles
Upright Effect: You may place a card in your Future position. You may exchange its position with another card on your spread and reverse either card.
Reversed Effect: If you have fewer than 2 cards in hand, draw until you have 2 cards in hand.

Name: Queen of Pentacles
Upright Effect: Move 3 cards from your deck to your memory. The next time you would place a card, you may place a card from your memory instead.
Reversed Effect: Deal 2 damage to a player, then gain life equal to the damage dealt this way.

Name: King of Pentacles
Upright Effect: Dismiss all Major cards, then dismiss this card. For each card dismissed, its player may draw.
Reversed Effect: Dismiss all Minor cards, including this card. For each card dismissed, its player may draw.

Name: Ace of Swords
Upright Effect: Choose Wands, Cups, or Swords. For each card of the chosen suit, including yours, deal 2 damage to its player.
Reversed Effect: Dismiss a card. Its player may place another card in its place.

Name: 2 of Swords
Upright Effect: Choose a player. They may exchange the positions of any cards on their spread. If they do, they may reverse those cards.
Reversed Effect: Reverse all cards, including this card.

Name: 3 of Swords
Upright Effect: Silence a card.
Reversed Effect: Prevent the next instance of damage that would be dealt to you.

Name: 4 of Swords
Upright Effect: Exchange a card on your spread with a card on another player's spread. You may reverse those cards.
Reversed Effect: Deal 3 damage to the player with the most life. In the event of a tie, you choose which player.

Name: 5 of Swords
Upright Effect: Dismiss this card, then dismiss any other card.
Reversed Effect: Choose another player. You and that player each draw.

Name: 6 of Swords
Upright Effect: Dismiss a Wand.
Reversed Effect: Name a card. Cards with the chosen name cannot be dismissed until your next turn.

Name: 7 of Swords
Upright Effect: Dismiss this card, then take any card and place it in this card’s position. You may reverse it.
Reversed Effect: Reverse a card.

Name: 8 of Swords
Upright Effect: Dismiss a card on the spread of the player with the most life. In the event of a tie, you choose.
Reversed Effect: Reverse a card.

Name: 9 of Swords
Upright Effect: The next time you would place a card, you may dismiss a card instead.
Reversed Effect: Reverse a card.

Name: 10 of Swords
Upright Effect: Exchange a card on your spread with a card on another player's spread. You may reverse those cards.
Reversed Effect: Shuffle up to 3 cards of your choice from your memory into your deck.

Name: Page of Swords
Upright Effect: Choose a number from 0 to 3. Each player, including you, draws that many.
Reversed Effect: Silence a card on each player's spread, including yours.

Name: Knight of Swords
Upright Effect: The next time you place a card, you may activate it and silence it.
Reversed Effect: Each player simultaneously chooses a number. Deal damage to each player equal to the number they chose. Dismiss a card on the spread of each player who chose the smallest number.

Name: Queen of Swords
Upright Effect: Dismiss a card from each player's spread, including yours.
Reversed Effect: Name a card. Cards with the chosen name do not activate until your next turn.

Name: King of Swords
Upright Effect: Dismiss all cards, including this one.
Reversed Effect: You may dismiss any number of cards on your spread. Each opponent dismisses that many cards on their spread.

Name: Ace of Wands
Upright Effect: Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Until the end of this turn, whenever you place a card, you may place one of those cards and remove the rest from the game.
Reversed Effect: Dismiss a card on your spread and place a card.

Name: 2 of Wands
Upright Effect: Until the end of this turn, the next time a you would deal damage, deal double that damage instead. This can stack.
Reversed Effect: Place a card. The next time you would place a card, do not.

Name: 3 of Wands
Upright Effect: Deal 2 damage to a player if this card is in the Past position, 3 damage if this card is in the Present position, or 4 damage if this card is in the Future position.
Reversed Effect: Dismiss a Minor card. Its player reveals the top card of their deck. If it’s a Minor card, they may place it in the same position.

Name: 4 of Wands
Upright Effect: Dismiss this card, then place a card. Each player discards their hand then draws 3.
Reversed Effect: You may reveal any number of cards in your hand. Deal 2 damage to a player for each Wand you reveal plus each Wand on your spread, including this one.

Name: 5 of Wands
Upright Effect: Deal 3 damage to a player. Flip this card. You may flip a face-down card at any time to activate it and silence it.
Reversed Effect: Deal 1 damage to each opponent.

Name: 6 of Wands
Upright Effect: Activate another card on your spread.
Reversed Effect: Silence a card on your spread.

Name: 7 of Wands
Upright Effect: Until your next turn, whenever a card on your spread is dismissed, deal 5 damage to any player.
Reversed Effect: Discard a card. If you do, deal 4 damage to a player.

Name: 8 of Wands
Upright Effect: Deal 3 damage to a player, then replace this card with one from your hand or deck. It does not activate until your next turn.
Reversed Effect: Dismiss a card. Until your next turn, whenever its player would place a card, they may place that card instead.

Name: 9 of Wands
Upright Effect: Deal damage to a player equal to the total number of damage you've dealt this turn, plus 1.
Reversed Effect: You may remove a card from your memory from the game and return a card from your memory to your hand.

Name: 10 of Wands
Upright Effect: Deal 3 damage to a player for each Cups card on their spread.
Reversed Effect: Deal 2 damage to a player for each Major card on their spread.

Name: Page of Wands
Upright Effect: Exchange this card with another card. You may reverse either card.
Reversed Effect: The next time you would place a card, you may deal 5 damage to any player instead.

Name: Knight of Wands
Upright Effect: You may replace this card with one from your hand and activate the new card.
Reversed Effect: Activate another card on your spread twice, then silence it.

Name: Queen of Wands
Upright Effect: Choose Wands, Cups, or Pentacles. Dismiss all cards of that suit. Dismiss this card.
Reversed Effect: Until your next turn, the next time you activate a card, activate it an additional time.

Name: King of Wands
Upright Effect: Deal 3 damage to each opponent.
Reversed Effect: Reveal the top 2 cards of your deck. Until the end of this turn, whenever you would place a card, you may place one of those cards instead and remove the other from the game.

Name: Ace of Cups
Upright Effect: Look at the top card of your deck. You may put it on the top or bottom of your deck. Draw.
Reversed Effect: You may place a card face-down. You may flip a face-down card at any time to activate it and silence it.

Name: 2 of Cups
Upright Effect: Draw for each Cup on your spread. You may reverse this card.
Reversed Effect: Deal damage to an opponent equal to the number of cards in your hand.

Name: 3 of Cups
Upright Effect: Activate each other card on your spread in any order.
Reversed Effect: Flip a card on your spread. You may flip a face-down card at any time to activate it and silence it.

Name: 4 of Cups
Upright Effect: You may place a card face-down. You may flip a face-down card at any time to activate it and silence it.
Reversed Effect: Return all cards on your spread, including this one, to your hand.

Name: 5 of Cups
Upright Effect: Copy an effect that has activated this turn.
Reversed Effect: You may shuffle your hand into your deck and draw that many.

Name: 6 of Cups
Upright Effect: Restart the turn from the Past. Silence this card.
Reversed Effect: Copy an effect of either side of a card.

Name: 7 of Cups
Upright Effect: Choose 2 cards on the same spread. That player chooses a card from among those. Dismiss that card.
Reversed Effect: Deal damage to a player equal to the number of cards in your hand.

Name: 8 of Cups
Upright Effect: For each opponent, return a card on their spread to their hand. Dismiss this card.
Reversed Effect: Flip a card on your spread or place one face-down. You may flip a face-down card at any time to activate it and silence it.

Name: 9 of Cups
Upright Effect: You may end the turn and flip this card. You may flip it at any time to activate it and silence it.
Reversed Effect: Copy an effect of either side of a card.

Name: 10 of Cups
Upright Effect: You may reveal any number of cards in your hand. Draw for each Cup you reveal plus each Cup on your spread, including this one.
Reversed Effect: Dismiss this card. Return all cards to their players' hands.

Name: Page of Cups
Upright Effect: Each player reveals the top card of their deck. You may draw.
Reversed Effect: You may place a card face-down. You may flip a face-down card at any time to activate it and silence it.

Name: Knight of Cups
Upright Effect: Copy an effect of either side of a card in your memory.
Reversed Effect: Choose a player. That player puts 3 cards from their deck into their memory.

Name: Queen of Cups
Upright Effect: Name a card. Until your next turn, cards with the chosen name cannot be dismissed, removed from the game, or placed.
Reversed Effect: Return any number of cards from your memory to your hand, then discard that many.

Name: King of Cups
Upright Effect: Each player, including you, may draw. Until your next turn, each player who draws this way may not damage you or dismiss cards on your spread.
Reversed Effect: Flip any number of cards on your spread. You may flip a face-down card at any time to activate it and silence it.
